title: Sprint-lite coverage and burn annotated census
content:
Purpose:
Quick, one-page ad-hoc census to surface weekend and off-hours coverage gaps for next 2 sprints and a lightweight burn estimate for temporary liaison support. Use this as the primary artifact for the oncall/coverage sync and to seed a short Slack rollcall.

Context notes:
- Trigger: unexpected bump in inference fallbacks on hosted tier (token burn spike on region-us-west) and several recently scheduled launches.
- Goal: identify 6–8 low-effort owners to buy 0.5–2 weeks each of focused surge work to close immediate gaps.
- Not a formal runbook — tactical, surface-only.

Snapshot table (rows are compact; hours are weekly estimate):
Owner | Role | Est. weekly burn (hrs) | Current coverage (%) | Primary ask / notes
Priya Shah | Prod-ops lead | 6 | 65 | Coordinate cross-team rota; own slack rollcall (#ops-weekend)
Daniel Park | Serving-runtime eng | 10 | 50 | Verify hot routes; fast patch for route-level throttle config
Sarah Liu | Observability | 8 | 40 | Add two quick-sampling traces for fallback paths; short dashboards
Miguel Torres | SE / field liaison | 4 | 75 | Customer-facing triage and quick docs for known partners
Anita Bose | SRE (backfill) | 12 | 30 | Short-lived runbook + pager coverage for 3 weekends
TBD (rota) | Support eng | 6 | 20 | Night shift liaison (on-call overlap)

Toplines / quick math (for exec summary)
- Net available burn for next 2 weeks (sum of listed owners): ~46 hrs/wk.
- Target burn to stabilize fallbacks + patching: ~60 hrs/wk for 2wks => gap ~14 hrs/wk.
- Suggested short-term delta: pull 1 engineer (8 hrs/wk) from infra backlog + 1 PM (4 hrs/wk) for coordination to close gap.

Risk triage (quick):
- High: route-level throttles not applied consistently across regions -> can cascade. Owner: Daniel Park.
- Medium: gaps in fallback telemetry (missing trace tags) -> owner: Sarah Liu.
- Low: partner-facing docs stale -> owner: Miguel Torres.

Immediate asks (1–3 day actions):
- Daniel: drop a 1-paragraph plan in JIRA-PRODOPS-812 for throttle sweep (due EOD +2 days).
- Sarah: add a lightweight sample query and two charts to the Ops dashboard (due +3 days).
- Priya: run rollcall in #ops-weekend, collect confirmation roster (due +2 days).

If-we-can-staff (contingency):
- If we secure Anita for two weekends (12 hrs/wk) and a support eng (6 hrs/wk), we hit target burn and can shift Daniel to a 60% effort on longer-term fixes.

Notes to reviewers (informal):
- This is intentionally terse; please add rows for other contributors and update hours conservatively.
- Link any PRs or runbooks directly in the JIRA ticket (use linked_artifacts above).
- If you think a full rotation is needed, call it out and we’ll escalate to Eng leadership.

History / provenance:
- Created during ad-hoc cross-team sync 2026-07-15.
- Updated after backlog scrub and quick SRE check on 2026-08-02.

Change log (brief):
- 2026-07-15: initial census (Priya).
- 2026-07-20: added Anita as potential SRE backfill (Daniel).
- 2026-08-02: adjusted hours after telemetry sample (Sarah).

Useful links / shortcuts:
- JIRA: JIRA-PRODOPS-812 (throttle sweep)
- Confluence: CONFLUENCE-PRD-3421 (context doc)
- Slack: #ops-weekend (rollcall channel)

Quick template for rollcall post (copy/paste):
"Weekend rollcall: Please reply with availability (EST timezone) and if you can contribute at least 6 hrs. Owners listed in the census: Priya, Daniel, Sarah, Miguel, Anita. Please confirm by EOD +2 days or we will pull infra backfill"

Open questions (for sprint planning):
- Are there any capacity-free engineers in infra that can be seconded for 2wks? (Priya to escalate)
- Do we want to convert this to a formal on-call rota later? (discuss at next ops sync)

Bottom line: This is a short-lived, pragmatic census to close a 2-week stabilization window. Keep edits light and rapid; aim to lock owners within 48 hours.
